paragraphs.en: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery, however, poses fundamentally different challenges: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. To address this gap, we introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments featuring scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. Beyond binary task completion, FDE-Gym scores agents on how much their delivered system improves the customer’s own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution); scores are penalized for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time) to discourage excessive or careless engagement. FDE-Gym also provides an online platform where humans can develop and practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的智能体基准测试通常通过问题报告、规范说明或任务工单中明确定义的任务来评估智能体。 然而，真实世界的客户交付面临根本不同的挑战：前线部署工程师（FDE）必须澄清模糊的需求，在运行中的系统中工作，并发现未明确说明的约束条件。 为了解决这一问题，我们推出了 FDE-Gym——一个包含 95 项端到端交付任务的基准测试，这些任务来自 18 个行业的 20 个客户场景，并由行业专家根据真实世界的交付项目进行了调整。 在模拟的客户环境中，智能体需要与预设的 stakeholder 互动，并在类似生产环境的系统中操作，以交付可用的解决方案；该环境包含脚本化的 stakeholder 和可修改的客户系统。 FDE-Gym 不仅评估任务是否完成，还根据智能体所交付的系统对客户自身成功指标的提升程度进行评分（评分范围从 0，表示系统无变化，到 1，表示达到参考方案）；同时，为了减少过度或草率的互动，系统会对 stakeholder 互动（包括消息、试运行和等待时间）进行扣分。 FDE-Gym 还提供了一个在线平台，人类可以在相同的评分标准下开发和练习 FDE 技能。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting (unstated constraints need to be discovered), the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56, and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. However, information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it achieves a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了来自七家提供商的 13 种模型配置。 在现实场景中（未明确说明的约束条件需要被发现），最佳配置的 FDE-Gym 平均得分为 0.56，且仅解决了 95 个任务中的 14 个（即无事件发生的得分至少为 0.8）。 发现未明确说明的约束条件是主要瓶颈：当模型必须在没有明确指导的情况下发现这些约束时，性能会急剧下降。 然而，仅凭信息发现本身无法解释这一差距：即使在最佳配置能够从利益相关者处获取所有关键事实的 23 个任务中，它也只有 10 个任务的归一化业务提升值达到 0.8 或更高。

paragraphs.en: These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers. Closing this gap requires agents that can surface unstated constraints, operate reliably in live systems, and achieve measurable improvements on customer metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果揭示了解决明确定义的任务与为真实客户提供有效的 AI 系统之间存在巨大差距。 要弥合这一差距，需要智能体能够识别未明确说明的约束条件、在实时系统中可靠运行，并在客户指标上实现可量化的改进。

paragraphs.en: Deploying AI in enterprise settings requires more than meeting stated customer requirements. The challenge often lies in identifying which changes will improve customer operations in practice. One scenario in our benchmark illustrates this problem. A vice president at a drilling operator seeks a generative-AI success story for the November board meeting. The vice president requests a daily summary email and an “Ask your wells” chat box, noting that the downtime-coding system is already in place and therefore outside the project scope.
paragraphs.zh: 在企业环境中部署人工智能，需要做的不仅仅是满足客户明确提出的要求。 真正的挑战通常在于确定哪些具体变化能够在实际中改善客户的运营。 我们基准测试中的一个场景就说明了这个问题。 一家钻井公司的副总裁正在为十一月的董事会会议寻找一个生成式人工智能的成功案例。 这位副总裁要求每天收到一封摘要邮件和一个“询问你的油井”聊天框，并指出停机时间编码系统已经存在，因此不在本项目范围内。

paragraphs.en: Yet a solution built strictly to the task instruction can be delivered on time, pass every functional check, and still fail to move the customer’s own business metric by a single point. The bottleneck lies in monthly downtime credit claims. The existing keyword-based script incorrectly attributes some downtime to the contractor, resulting in at least one disputed line each month and suspending the credit for that month. Addressing this problem requires revisiting the downtime-coding system that the sponsor had explicitly excluded from the project scope. The engineer must identify the applicable contractual rule, confirm the interpretation with the cost engineer, and obtain approval for the change from an approver who is unavailable that week.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一个完全按照任务说明构建的解决方案可能能按时交付，通过所有功能检查，却仍然无法让客户的业务指标提升哪怕一个百分点。 瓶颈在于每月的停机时间信用索赔。 现有的基于关键词的脚本错误地将部分停机时间归因于承包商，导致每月至少出现一条争议项，并暂停该月份的信用发放。 要解决这个问题，需要重新审视停机时间编码系统——而发起方此前已明确将其排除在项目范围之外。 工程师必须确定适用的合同规则，与成本工程师确认解释，并获得审批人的变更批准，但该审批人当周无法联系。

paragraphs.en: This is the role of a forward-deployed engineer (FDE), an engineer assigned by a vendor to work within a customer organization. The role involves more than building what the sponsor initially requests. An FDE must identify what will actually help and work with customer systems and stakeholders to deliver the improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是前置部署工程师（FDE）的职责，即由供应商指派到客户组织内部工作的工程师。 这一角色所承担的工作并不仅限于构建赞助方最初提出的需求。 FDE 必须明确哪些措施能真正带来帮助，并与客户的系统及利益相关者合作，以实现改进目标。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks rarely address this last mile of AI delivery, typically assuming that the problem has already been well defined. Software-engineering benchmarks provide issues and hidden tests [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , deployment benchmarks provide specifications [ 4 ] , enterprise benchmarks provide predefined tasks [ 5 , 6 ] , and clarification benchmarks withhold information from an otherwise correctly specified task [ 7 , 8 ] — in each case, the underlying problem remains fixed. Recent benchmarks come closer to real-world delivery. τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9 ] evaluates agents that build customer-service systems from client requirements and deploy the resulting systems against held-out users. A post-training benchmark [ 10 ] assigns agents the role of forward-deployed engineers and evaluates whether the delivered model improves performance. XYEval [ 11 ] tests agents on misleading user requests. However, these benchmarks still address individual aspects of delivery in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试很少涉及人工智能交付的这“最后一公里”，通常假设问题已经得到了很好的定义。 软件工程基准测试提供问题和隐藏测试 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ]，部署基准测试提供规格说明 [ 4]，企业基准测试提供预定义任务 [ 5 , 6]，而澄清基准测试则会从原本正确指定的任务中隐瞒信息 [ 7 , 8]——在每种情况下，底层问题都保持不变。 近期的基准测试更贴近现实世界的交付过程。τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9] 评估那些根据客户需求构建客户服务系统，并将最终系统部署给预留用户的智能体。 一项训练后基准测试 [ 10] 赋予智能体前线部署工程师的角色，并评估所交付的模型是否提升了性能。 XYEval [ 11] 通过具有误导性的用户请求来测试智能体。 然而，这些基准测试仍然孤立地处理交付过程中的各个独立方面。

sents.zh: 现有的基准测试很少涉及人工智能交付的这“最后一公里”，通常假设问题已经得到了很好的定义。

sents.en: Software-engineering benchmarks provide issues and hidden tests [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , deployment benchmarks provide specifications [ 4 ] , enterprise benchmarks provide predefined tasks [ 5 , 6 ] , and clarification benchmarks withhold information from an otherwise correctly specified task [ 7 , 8 ] — in each case, the underlying problem remains fixed.
sents.zh: 软件工程基准测试提供问题和隐藏测试 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ]，部署基准测试提供规格说明 [ 4]，企业基准测试提供预定义任务 [ 5 , 6]，而澄清基准测试则会从原本正确指定的任务中隐瞒信息 [ 7 , 8]——在每种情况下，底层问题都保持不变。

sents.en: Recent benchmarks come closer to real-world delivery. τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9 ] evaluates agents that build customer-service systems from client requirements and deploy the resulting systems against held-out users.
sents.zh: 近期的基准测试更贴近现实世界的交付过程。τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9] 评估那些根据客户需求构建客户服务系统，并将最终系统部署给预留用户的智能体。

sents.en: A post-training benchmark [ 10 ] assigns agents the role of forward-deployed engineers and evaluates whether the delivered model improves performance.
sents.zh: 一项训练后基准测试 [ 10] 赋予智能体前线部署工程师的角色，并评估所交付的模型是否提升了性能。

sents.en: XYEval [ 11 ] tests agents on misleading user requests.
sents.zh: XYEval [ 11] 通过具有误导性的用户请求来测试智能体。

sents.en: However, these benchmarks still address individual aspects of delivery in isolation.
sents.zh: 然而，这些基准测试仍然孤立地处理交付过程中的各个独立方面。

paragraphs.en: FDE-Gym addresses these challenges in a single benchmark of 95 tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. The sponsor’s request may target the wrong problem, critical constraints must be discovered through stakeholder interaction, and performance is measured using the customer’s own business metric. A solution that addresses the wrong problem therefore earns no credit.
paragraphs.zh: FDE-Gym 在一个包含 95 项任务的单一基准测试中应对这些挑战，这些任务来自 18 个行业的 20 种客户场景，每个场景都由行业专家根据真实世界的交付项目进行调整。 赞助方的需求可能针对了错误的问题，必须通过利益相关者互动发现关键约束条件，并且性能评估将使用客户自身的业务指标进行衡量。 因此，解决错误问题的方案将无法获得任何认可。

paragraphs.en: Delivered systems are deployed without modification and evaluated on held-out production data. The FDE-Gym score measures improvement on the customer’s own business metric after deducting stakeholder contact cost (Section 2.3 details what is charged). The do-nothing baseline (the unchanged system) scores 0, the expert-authored reference solution scores 1, and literal compliance with the sponsor’s request scores at most 0.2. Experimental results show that current models perform well below the reference solution on this scale.
paragraphs.zh: 交付的系统未经修改即可部署，并在预留的生产数据上进行评估。 FDE-Gym 分数衡量的是在扣除利益相关者沟通成本后，客户自身业务指标的提升情况（第 2.3 节详细说明了收费内容）。 “不作为”基线（即未变更的系统）得分为 0，由专家编写的参考解决方案得分为 1，而完全按照赞助方要求执行则最多得 0.2。 实验结果表明，当前模型在该评分标准上的表现远低于参考解决方案。

paragraphs.en: To identify where agents fail, we present each scenario at four task instruction levels with progressively less information (from a fully specified problem (L0) down to the sponsor’s original request, which may not address the underlying problem (L3)). The environment, stakeholders, and grader remain unchanged across all four levels. Because only the task instruction varies, differences in performance isolate the effect of the information withheld. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers using this setup. Five main findings emerge.
paragraphs.zh: 为了确定智能体在何处出现失败，我们在每个场景下提供了四个不同任务说明层级，信息量逐级减少（从完全明确的问题（L0）到发起方最初的请求，该请求可能并未触及根本问题（L3））。 在所有四个层级中，环境、利益相关者和评分者均保持不变。 由于只有任务说明发生了变化，因此性能差异能够单独反映所隐藏信息的影响。 我们使用这一设置评估了来自七家提供商的 13 种模型配置。 研究得出五个主要发现。

sents.zh: 为了确定智能体在何处出现失败，我们在每个场景下提供了四个不同任务说明层级，信息量逐级减少（从完全明确的问题（L0）到发起方最初的请求，该请求可能并未触及根本问题（L3））。

sents.en: We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers using this setup.
sents.zh: 我们使用这一设置评估了来自七家提供商的 13 种模型配置。

sents.en: Five main findings emerge.

paragraphs.en: Even the best model configuration falls well short of the reference solution. At L3, Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest mean score of 0.56 and resolves 14 of 95 tasks, while five of the thirteen configurations resolve none. Selecting the best-performing configuration for each task still yields a score of only 0.70, with 30 tasks resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 即便是最佳模型配置，其表现也远不及参考解决方案。 在 L3 级别，Claude Opus 5.5 获得了最高的平均得分 0.56，并解决了 95 项任务中的 14 项，而十三种配置中有五种一项也未能解决。 即使为每项任务选择表现最佳的配置，最终得分也只有 0.70，共解决了 30 项任务。

sents.zh: 即便是最佳模型配置，其表现也远不及参考解决方案。

sents.zh: 即使为每项任务选择表现最佳的配置，最终得分也只有 0.70，共解决了 30 项任务。

paragraphs.en: Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck for leading models. When the relevant rules and constraints are provided, the three leading models score 0.73–0.82. Requiring these models to discover the constraints reduces scores sharply to 0.39–0.62. On the original tasks, L3 scores are at most 0.08 points lower than L1 scores.
paragraphs.zh: 发现未明确陈述的约束条件，是领先模型面临的主要瓶颈。 当提供相关规则和约束条件时，三款领先模型的得分在 0.73–0.82 之间。 若要求这些模型自行发现约束条件，其得分会急剧下降至 0.39–0.62。 在原始任务中，L3 的得分最多比 L1 低 0.08 分。

sents.zh: 发现未明确陈述的约束条件，是领先模型面临的主要瓶颈。

sents.en: On the original tasks, L3 scores are at most 0.08 points lower than L1 scores.

paragraphs.en: Obtaining the necessary information does not ensure effective delivery. At L3, leading models obtain 72–85% of the key facts available from stakeholders, yet the delivered systems achieve only 0.60–0.70 of the reference improvement. Stakeholder contact cost reduces the final scores by a further 0.14–0.22.
paragraphs.zh: 获取必要信息并不保证能够有效交付。 在 L3 阶段，领先模型能够从利益相关者处获取 72%–85% 的关键事实，但所交付的系统仅实现了参考改进值的 0.60–0.70。 与利益相关者接触所产生的成本会使最终得分进一步降低 0.14–0.22。

paragraphs.en: We make three contributions. First, we introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark that evaluates whether agents can identify the underlying customer problem and deliver a working solution that measurably improves business outcomes. Second, we develop a methodology for constructing scenarios that combines task variants, scripted stakeholders, and predefined scoring anchors to support reproducible evaluation and limit rewards for literal compliance and shortcut solutions. Third, we evaluate 13 model configurations and provide an online platform where humans and agents can practice delivery under the same grading criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了三项贡献。 首先，我们引入了 FDE-Gym——一个基准测试，用于评估智能体是否能够识别根本的客户问题，并提供能够切实改善业务成果的有效解决方案。 其次，我们开发了一种构建场景的方法论，该方法结合了任务变体、预设的利益相关者以及预定义的评分锚点，以支持可重复的评估，并限制仅因字面遵守规则或采用捷径方案而获得的奖励。 第三，我们对 13 种模型配置进行了评估，并提供了一个在线平台，供人类和智能体在相同的评分标准下练习解决方案交付。

paragraphs.en: The agent starts in a workspace containing the task instruction (the description of the work assigned by the sponsor), a copy of the customer’s production system, relevant documents and historical data, and a staff directory with contact details. The runtime environment provides standard Python and SQLite. Installing additional packages and accessing the general network are prohibited. The delivered system may send network requests only to the company’s LLM gateway, which charges according to usage. Once delivery is complete, the contents of system/ are deployed to production without modification. Production continues to call the original entry points, so new functionality must be integrated with these entry points to take effect.

paragraphs.en: The four task instruction levels (Table 1) distinguish the challenges of implementation, constraint discovery, and problem clarification by varying the task instruction while keeping the environment and evaluation criteria fixed. The L0 instruction explicitly states the underlying problem, relevant rules and constraints, and scoring criteria, leaving the agent to design and implement a solution. The L1 instruction withholds the rules and constraints, while the L2 instruction also provides only a vague description of the problem. The L3 instruction presents the sponsor’s original request, requiring the agent to assess whether the request addresses the underlying problem. We use L3 as the primary evaluation setting because this level most closely reflects the starting point of real-world customer delivery projects. L0 does not eliminate the need for engineering decisions. By specifying the rules while leaving solution design open, L0 measures what an agent can build when all underlying facts are provided.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 traces how a real delivery becomes a task in the benchmark. Industry experts adapted real-world customer delivery projects carried out in China, Singapore, and the United States since 2024 into 20 scenarios spanning 18 sectors (Table 2). Each scenario yields an original task and several variants of it, which share a common customer environment but differ in key facts. Each original task and each variant is a separate benchmark task, for a total of 95 tasks. Tasks require agents to deliver an agent, workflow, or service that operates in the customer’s environment. The scenarios are grounded in industry practice, with the relevant regulations, standards, and public sources documented. Companies and individuals are either de-identified or fictional, and some data are adapted from real-world industry sources.

paragraphs.en: A single fixed task per scenario may allow models to rely on memorized solutions or recurring patterns. To reduce this risk, experts designed two to seven variants in addition to each scenario’s original task. Variants change key facts, including which rule is outdated, who holds critical information, and whether the sponsor’s request addresses the underlying problem. These changes may require different delivery solutions, so a solution that succeeds on one task of a scenario may fail on another. Across scenarios, no single problem pattern appears in more than one-third of the set. Together, these design choices encourage agents to evaluate the evidence in each task rather than apply a fixed solution.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景中的单一固定任务可能会让模型依赖记忆中的解决方案或重复出现的模式。 为了降低这种风险，专家们在每个场景的原始任务之外，又设计了两种到七种变体任务。 这些变体会改变关键事实，包括哪条规则已经过时、谁掌握着关键信息，以及发起人的请求是否解决了根本问题。 这些变化可能需要不同的解决方案，因此在一个场景的某项任务中成功的方案，在另一项任务中可能会失败。 在所有场景中，没有任何一种问题模式会出现在超过三分之一的场景集合中。 综合来看，这些设计选择鼓励智能体评估每个任务中的证据，而不是直接套用固定的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: FDE-Gym simulates more than 130 customer stakeholders across its 20 scenarios. Stakeholder responses are scripted for reproducibility, as switching the user-simulation model can shift measured agent success rates by several percentage points [ 14 ] . A small model maps questions to topics, while each stakeholder’s knowledge, misconceptions, and conditions for disclosing information are fixed in advance. The scripts incorporate limited patience, requirements for supporting evidence, dependencies on prior conversations, temporary unavailability, and contact restrictions. Agents must infer stakeholder roles and communication constraints from customer documents.
paragraphs.zh: FDE-Gym 在其 20 个场景中模拟了超过 130 名客户利益相关者。 利益相关者的回应经过脚本编写以确保可重复性，因为切换用户模拟模型可能会使测得智能体的成功率发生几个百分点的变化 [ 14 ] 。 一个小模型将问题映射到主题，而每个利益相关者的知识、误解以及信息披露条件都是预先固定的。 这些脚本包含了有限的耐心、对支持性证据的要求、对先前对话的依赖、暂时不可用以及接触限制等因素。 智能体必须从客户文档中推断出利益相关者的角色和沟通限制。

paragraphs.en: Each task included in FDE-Gym must satisfy four predefined scoring anchors (Figure 3). (1) The reference solution must score at least 0.95. (2) The do-nothing baseline must score 0. (3) The literal solution, which implements exactly what the task instruction asks for without seeking any further constraint, must score at most 0.2. This condition holds even when the sponsor’s request identifies the right problem, because the constraints omitted from the task instruction still determine the outcome. The only exception is a task in which the sponsor’s request is both correct and complete; there the literal solution coincides with the reference solution and must score at least 0.95, so that distrusting the sponsor is never a universally rewarded strategy. (4) Shortcut strategies must score at most 0.8. These strategies include overfitting to historical data, guessing round-number thresholds, and deferring all uncertain decisions to humans. Scores are capped near zero if an agent attempts to bypass customer controls or manipulate the grader. The graders were tested against more than 270 shortcut and bypass strategies. Agents that solve tasks using only customer documents and data are scored on the same basis as those that interact with stakeholders.

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We evaluate models at four task instruction levels (L0–L3), from a fully specified problem to the sponsor’s original request. L3 is the primary setting, reflecting real-world delivery where the request may not address the underlying problem. It covers all 95 tasks: 20 original tasks and 75 variants with altered key facts. To measure the effect of information provided in the task instruction on performance, we also evaluate L0–L2 on the original tasks. Three scenarios have identical L2 and L3 task instructions; for these, the L3 run on the original task also serves as the L2 result, so all four levels are reported on the same 20 original tasks. Each model is therefore run on 20 tasks at L0, 20 at L1, 17 at L2, and 95 at L3, totaling 152 task–instruction-level combinations per model and 1,976 across all 13 model configurations. Each combination is run three times, and the scores are averaged. Each run ends when the agent submits its delivery or reaches a limit of 200 turns, 150 minutes, or USD 8 in model usage cost, whichever comes first. The system is then deployed and evaluated in the state reached at that point.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 我们在四个任务指令层级（L0–L3）上对模型进行评估，范围从完全明确的问题到发起方的原始请求。 L3 是主要设置，反映了现实世界中的交付场景，其中请求可能并未涵盖潜在的根本问题。 它涵盖了全部 95 项任务：20 项原始任务和 75 项通过改变关键事实生成的变体任务。 为了衡量任务指令中提供的信息对性能的影响，我们还在原始任务上评估了 L0–L2。 三种场景的 L2 和 L3 任务指令完全相同；对于这些场景，在原始任务上运行的 L3 结果也同时作为 L2 的结果，因此所有四个层级都在相同的 20 项原始任务上报告。 因此，每个模型分别在 L0 上运行 20 项任务、L1 上运行 20 项、L2 上运行 17 项以及 L3 上运行 95 项，总计每个模型有 152 种任务–指令层级组合，所有 13 种模型配置共有 1,976 种组合。 每种组合均运行三次，并对得分取平均值。 每次运行在智能体提交其交付结果或达到以下任一限制时结束：200 轮交互、150 分钟或 8 美元模型使用成本，以先到者为准。 随后，系统在该时刻所处的状态下进行部署和评估。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with other benchmarks. We compare FDE-Gym scores with task success rates on Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 2 ] , Vibe Code Bench [ 12 ] , and Finance Agent [ 13 ] , using results from Vals AI (vals.ai/benchmarks, accessed 6 October 2026). The other benchmarks cited in this paper are not run by this source, and SWE-bench Verified is no longer run on new models there, so comparable results are not available for the models shown. For each provider, we show its best-performing model on FDE-Gym among those evaluated in our study with results available on all three external benchmarks. paragraphs.en: Figure 2 and Table 3 present the main results. At L3, Claude Opus 5.5 leads with 0.56 (95% interval 0.50 to 0.62), followed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 at 0.49, GPT-6 Astra at 0.38, and GPT-6.1 Sol at 0.37. We refer to the first three as the three leading models throughout, with GPT-6.1 Sol just below them. paragraphs.en: Figure 8 compares FDE-Gym with three public benchmarks covering work that precedes delivery. These benchmarks evaluate engineering tasks in a terminal (Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 2 ] ), complete web application development from a specification (Vibe Code Bench [ 12 ] ), and research tasks performed by financial analysts (Finance Agent [ 13 ] ). Dashed outlines show normalized business uplift before deducting stakeholder contact cost. Models that solve up to 88%, 90%, and 61% of tasks on these three benchmarks, respectively, score 0.19–0.56 on FDE-Gym. Because task success rates and normalized business uplift are different quantities, the figure places them side by side on their respective scales without treating the difference as a directly comparable gap. The closest counterpart to a success rate in FDE-Gym is the proportion of resolved tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Among the models shown in Figure 8, the leading model Claude Opus 5.5 resolves 14 of 95 tasks (15%). For a customer, the practical implication is that a model’s performance on component benchmarks is a weak guide to what it will deliver: the same models that solve most terminal, coding, and research tasks improve the customer’s business metric in at most one of seven engagements.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 将 FDE-Gym 与三个涵盖交付前工作的公开基准进行了比较。 这些基准评估了终端中的工程任务（Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 2 ]）、根据规格完成整个 Web 应用开发（Vibe Code Bench [ 12 ]），以及金融分析师执行的研究任务（Finance Agent [ 13 ]）。 虚线轮廓显示了在扣除利益相关者接触成本之前的标准化业务提升。 在这些三个基准上分别能解决 88%、90% 和 61% 任务的模型，在 FDE-Gym 上的得分介于 0.19–0.56 之间。 由于任务成功率和标准化业务提升是不同的量，该图将它们分别置于各自的标度上并列展示，而未将差异视为可直接比较的差距。 在 FDE-Gym 中，与成功率最接近的对应指标是已解决任务的比例（即得分至少为 0.8 且未发生任何事件）。 在图 8 所示的模型中，表现领先的模型 Claude Opus 5.5 解决了 95 个任务中的 14 个（15%）。 对于客户而言，其实际含义是：模型在组件基准上的表现，并不能有效预测其最终交付成果；那些能解决大多数终端、编码和研究任务的同一模型，在七次互动中最多也只有一次能改善客户的业务指标。

paragraphs.en: The most closely related work was published within weeks of ours. τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9 ] makes agent construction the task: a developer agent receives a business’s records, a client who holds the requirements, an existing codebase, and limits on serving cost, and the customer-service agent it delivers is then deployed against held-out simulated users. Its strongest configuration passes 23.9% of simulations, compared with 82.2% for an expert-authored reference; we likewise find the best model well short of a reference written by experts. FDE-Gym differs in what it varies and in what it measures. The task instruction varies from a full statement of the rules to a request that may be misdirected, stakeholder contact incurs a charge, the result is measured as uplift on the customer’s business metric relative to a do-nothing baseline of zero, which a delivery can fall below, and the scenarios span 18 sectors and deliverables beyond customer-service agents. Trains but Doesn’t Learn [ 10 ] places an agent in the role of a forward-deployed engineer for model post-training and identifies the failure mode in which every check continues to pass while the delivered model is no better than the base model; our literal-compliance anchor is designed to expose the same kind of delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 最相关的工作在我们发表几周后也问世了。τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9 ] 将智能体构建作为任务：一个开发者智能体接收一家企业的记录、掌握需求的客户、现有的代码库以及服务成本限制，然后将其交付的客户服务智能体部署到预留的模拟用户环境中进行测试。 其最强配置通过了 23.9% 的模拟测试，而专家撰写的参考模型则达到了 82.2%；同样地，我们发现最佳模型的表现也远不及专家撰写的参考模型。 FDE-Gym 的不同之处在于它变化的要素和测量的指标。 任务说明从完整的规则陈述，到可能方向错误的请求不等；与利益相关者联系会产生费用，结果以客户业务指标相对于“什么都不做”基线（即零）的提升来衡量，而交付结果甚至可能低于该基线；测试场景涵盖 18 个行业，并涉及客户服务智能体之外的交付成果。 《训练但未学习》[ 10 ] 将智能体置于模型训练后部署的现场工程师角色中，并识别出一种故障模式：所有检查持续通过，但交付的模型并未优于基础模型；我们的字面合规锚点旨在暴露同类型的交付问题。

paragraphs.en: Two lines of work bear directly on our task instruction levels. XYEval [ 11 ] turns existing benchmarks, τ \tau 2 -bench [ 34 ] among them, into XY problems, in which the user asks about an attempted solution rather than the real problem, and reports relative drops of up to 46.7%. Our leading models lose little when the sponsor’s request is misdirected, perhaps because, within a full engagement, the documents, data, and stakeholders around the sponsor are all available to contradict it. UnderSpecBench [ 35 ] holds the environment and the correct action fixed while degrading the instruction along three axes, an isolation strategy that our task instruction levels also use, and finds that underspecification leads agents to guess rather than fail; Implicit Intelligence [ 23 ] reports a best pass rate of 48.3% on simple requests whose constraints must be discovered. Both are consistent with where our levels locate the largest drop: at the constraints that nobody stated.
paragraphs.zh: 两类工作直接影响我们的任务指令层级。 XYEval [ 11 ] 将现有基准测试（包括 τ \tau 2 -bench [ 34 ]）转化为 XY 问题，其中用户询问的是尝试性的解决方案而非真实问题，并报告了高达 46.7% 的相对下降。 当发起方的请求方向错误时，我们的领先模型损失甚微，或许是因为在整个协作过程中，与发起方相关的文件、数据和利益相关者均可用来说明该请求的不当之处。 UnderSpecBench [ 35 ] 在保持环境和正确动作不变的同时，沿三个维度削弱指令，这种隔离策略也被我们的任务指令层级所采用；研究结果表明，指令规格不足会导致智能体进行猜测而非直接失败；Implicit Intelligence [ 23 ] 报告称，在那些必须通过探索才能发现约束条件的简单请求中，最佳通过率达到了 48.3%。 这两项结果都与我们的层级模型所识别的最大下降点一致：即那些无人明确说明的约束条件处。

sents.en: Our leading models lose little when the sponsor’s request is misdirected, perhaps because, within a full engagement, the documents, data, and stakeholders around the sponsor are all available to contradict it.
sents.zh: 当发起方的请求方向错误时，我们的领先模型损失甚微，或许是因为在整个协作过程中，与发起方相关的文件、数据和利益相关者均可用来说明该请求的不当之处。

sents.en: UnderSpecBench [ 35 ] holds the environment and the correct action fixed while degrading the instruction along three axes, an isolation strategy that our task instruction levels also use, and finds that underspecification leads agents to guess rather than fail; Implicit Intelligence [ 23 ] reports a best pass rate of 48.3% on simple requests whose constraints must be discovered.
sents.zh: UnderSpecBench [ 35 ] 在保持环境和正确动作不变的同时，沿三个维度削弱指令，这种隔离策略也被我们的任务指令层级所采用；研究结果表明，指令规格不足会导致智能体进行猜测而非直接失败；Implicit Intelligence [ 23 ] 报告称，在那些必须通过探索才能发现约束条件的简单请求中，最佳通过率达到了 48.3%。

sents.en: Both are consistent with where our levels locate the largest drop: at the constraints that nobody stated.
sents.zh: 这两项结果都与我们的层级模型所识别的最大下降点一致：即那些无人明确说明的约束条件处。

paragraphs.en: Three of the benchmarks in Table 4 shaped FDE-Gym directly. TheAgentCompany [ 5 ] is the closest in form, a self-contained simulated company with colleagues to talk to; we keep the self-contained world and replace “a colleague assigned this task” with “a customer hired you”, and task completion with a business metric. LHAW [ 8 ] is the most systematic treatment of missing information and models the cost of asking; our L0 to L1 step reproduces its finding that agents rarely recover full-specification performance by asking, and our L3 adds a situation it does not cover: a request that is misdirected. Vending-Bench [ 30 ] showed that an executable business simulation can replace human judges; we attach one to an engineering deliverable.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 中的三个基准测试直接塑造了 FDE-Gym。 TheAgentCompany [ 5 ] 在形式上最为接近，它是一个自包含的模拟公司，内有可供交谈的同事；我们保留了这一自包含的世界，并将“一位同事分配了这项任务”替换为“一位客户雇佣了你”，同时将任务完成替换为一个业务指标。 LHAW [ 8 ] 是对缺失信息最系统的处理，并建模了提问的成本；我们的 L0 到 L1 步骤复现了其研究结论：智能体很少能通过提问恢复完全规格的性能，而我们的 L3 补充了一个它未涵盖的情况：请求被错误地转交。 Vending-Bench [ 30 ] 表明，一个可执行的业务模拟可以替代人类评判者；我们将其中一个与一个工程交付成果相结合。

paragraphs.en: Two methodological warnings also shaped the design. Results obtained against LLM-played users depend on which model plays the user [ 14 ] , which is why our stakeholders are scripted, and single-run success overstates reliability [ 36 , 37 ] , which is why every task is run three times. The admission anchors follow the practice of auditing an agentic benchmark with do-nothing and shortcut solutions before trusting its scores [ 38 ] . Beyond single benchmarks, long-horizon evaluations track the length of software tasks agents can complete [ 39 ] , and Collaborative Gym [ 40 ] studies agents working alongside people; FDE-Gym instead sets people and agents the same tasks separately, so that the two can be compared.
paragraphs.zh: 两种方法论上的警示也影响了设计。 在与 LLM 扮演的用户互动中获得的结果取决于由哪个模型扮演用户 [ 14 ]，因此我们的利益相关者都是按照脚本设定的，而单次运行的成功夸大了可靠性 [ 36 , 37 ]，这也是为什么每个任务都要运行三次的原因。 这些准入基准遵循了这样一种做法：在信任其分数之前，先使用“无所作为”和“走捷径”的解决方案来审计一个智能体基准 [ 38 ]。 除了单个基准之外，长期评估还追踪智能体能完成软件任务的时长 [ 39]；而 Collaborative Gym [ 40] 则研究智能体与人类协同工作的情形；相比之下，FDE-Gym 则是将相同任务分别分配给人类和智能体，以便对两者进行比较。

Real people are less predictable: they change their minds, answer a different question from the one asked, and may respond differently on the basis of previous interactions. paragraphs.en: Isolation and cost. Runs were executed on several hosts with process-level isolation of varying strength; each run’s record is audited after grading, but one container per run would provide a stronger guarantee. Model usage cost is as metered on the route through which each model was accessed and is not a comparison of list prices.
paragraphs.zh: 隔离与成本。 运行在多个主机上，这些主机的进程级隔离强度各不相同；每次运行的记录在评分后会经过审核，但每次运行使用一个容器将提供更强的保障。 模型使用成本根据访问每个模型的路径进行计量，并非对列表价格的比较。

paragraphs.en: Coverage and contamination. Twenty scenarios across 18 sectors are a sample of delivery work, weighted toward agents and workflows in regulated operations. The scenarios are adapted from real deliveries, and although companies are fictional and variants change the facts, we cannot rule out that related material is in the training data.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围与污染。 涵盖 18 个行业的 20 种场景是配送工作的样本，其中更侧重于受监管运营中的智能体和工作流程。 这些场景改编自真实配送案例；尽管相关公司是虚构的，且不同变体会改变具体事实，但我们无法排除训练数据中存在相关材料的可能性。

paragraphs.en: FDE-Gym measures an agent’s delivery the way a customer does: not by whether a system was delivered, but by whether the customer’s business improved. Measured in this way, the last mile of AI delivery remains long. The best of the thirteen configurations has an average FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves about one task in seven. The gap is not where we expected it to be. Leading models show little performance loss when the sponsor’s request is misdirected, and they obtain most of the facts held by stakeholders. Their principal performance losses arise when translating those facts into an effective system and from the stakeholder contact costs incurred during delivery. Weaker models lose more: on most tasks, the customer would have been better served by no delivery at all.
paragraphs.zh: FDE-Gym 衡量智能体交付效果的方式与顾客相同：不是看系统是否被交付，而是看顾客的业务是否得到改善。 以此方式衡量，AI 交付的“最后一公里”依然漫长。 在十三种配置中表现最佳的一种，其平均 FDE-Gym 得分为 0.56，大约每七项任务能成功解决一项。 这一差距并不出现在我们预期的位置。 当赞助方的请求被错误引导时，领先模型的性能损失很小，并且它们能够获取利益相关者所掌握的大多数事实。 它们主要的性能损失源于将这些事实转化为有效系统，以及交付过程中产生的与利益相关者接触的成本。 较弱的模型损失更大：在大多数任务中，不交付任何系统反而能为顾客提供更好的服务。

paragraphs.en: These are the capabilities an experienced engineer brings to a customer. Closing the gap is therefore a question of judgment in delivery, and FDE-Gym makes that judgment measurable: one number per task, on the customer’s own metric, for people and agents under the same rules.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是一位经验丰富的工程师能为客户带来的能力。 因此，弥合这一差距取决于交付过程中的判断力，而 FDE-Gym 使这种判断变得可衡量：针对每项任务，根据客户自身的指标，对人员和智能体在相同规则下的表现给出一个数值。
